basic_profile.bio: I'm a huge wrestling fan who recently dived into the world of Reddit to connect with other fans and discuss the latest WWE storylines. I live in Chicago and work as a graphic designer. My passion for wrestling started when I was a kid watching matches with my dad. Besides wrestling, I love anime and gaming, especially MOBAs. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and late nights after work. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time either gaming or catching up on wrestling events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in wrestling and anime, which I've nurtured through years of watching, reading fan theories, and engaging with online communities. My knowledge in gaming, particularly in MOBAs, comes from countless hours of playing and studying game mechanics.
